sn11.5:1.11: “Elder god” is _pubbadeva_. This victory by debate recalls Bṛhadāraṇyaka Upaniṣad 1.3.1, which explains that the titans are the elder children of Pajāpati, and the younger children, the gods, sought to overcome them by means of reciting the sacred word (_udgītha_), but the titans pierced it with the evil that is bad speech.
sn11.5:3.1: This suggests that anumodati meant something more exuberant than just “rejoicing”.
